confidence_notes: Meal and coffee anchors are the strongest, based on several aggregated Byron Bay and Australian cost-of-living sources adjusted to July 2026; the meal anchor excludes drinks. Beer is a judgment from Numbeo's Oct 2025 Byron Bay 0.5 L draft price scaled to a 425 ml schooner and checked against 2026 guides, not a measured average. Cocktail is set at about 2x the beer anchor and cross-checked against an awards-list average and general guides. Wine glass uses the beer relationship (about 1.25x) because no reliable 2026 glass-of-wine average was found. Accommodation is a holistic model estimate with no accommodation search or live listing check. FX is the RBA 18 Nov 2026 observation as reported in a search summary of the RBA exchange-rates page.
comparable_city_reasoning: No separate comparable city was needed for meals and coffee because Byron Bay has direct aggregated cost-of-living data. Beer, cocktail and wine rely on Australian national and NSW pub and bar benchmarks with a Byron tourist adjustment. Accommodation is a holistic estimate for a coastal Northern Rivers resort town in July, not a city-comparable calculation.
